propositions: Canonical bridge preview must execute exactly one ordinary dry-run differ pass and emit a single manifest containing both arbitrated plan entries and exact field-level drift from that same pass, without invoking or duplicating reconcile-check comparison.

Canonical preview must remain lock-free by bypassing pass-lock acquisition, purging, stealing, and writing while canonical sync retains deterministic applied/deferred tally; legacy reconcile-check and uncapped LIVE output remain unchanged.

The argparse parser must use allow_abbrev=False to reject undocumented prefix abbreviations (e.g., --dry-run) with invocation error 2 before any repository or lock access, while documented legacy options (--mode dry-run, --mode live, --mode reconcile-check) remain valid.

Canonical preview and canonical sync must emit field-comparable manifest envelopes with the same contract; canonical uncapped live retains its manifest and exact applied/failed tally while legacy uncapped LIVE callers preserve historical tally/no-retained-manifest behavior.

Legacy reconcile-check must retain its all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair semantics, lock-free execution, bridge_state/reconcile-check.json diagnostic artifact, and exit behavior unchanged across all calling conventions (CLI, library, MCP, workflows).

Documentation must explicitly guide operators to bridge preview for dry-run inspection and bridge sync for mutations, while preserving reconcile-check and legacy LIVE output vocabulary and observable behavior in release notes, user guide, and jira-sync-setup.
